texts.text: Equal vehicle performance. A match is the best of the chosen heats; the Ladder keeps your best heat. A tournament fills a knockout bracket with bots; their matches can be skipped. Selecting first before green, or less than 0.100 s after it, is a false start.
Race a human or a bot, or practise solo. Hold 4000-5000 RPM in N, select first on green, shift up before the limiter: too long in the red blows the engine.
